metadata.title: Groupicorn Hawai‘i IOP/PHP research directory
metadata.purpose: Internal discovery/proximity dataset for Groupicorn. Research only; not a clinical referral directory.
metadata.methodology: Physical-address-first. O‘ahu is subdivided into central, windward, and leeward catchments; Maui, Hawai‘i Island, Kaua‘i, and Moloka‘i are treated as separate island markets. Local provider groups are considered before explicitly named neighboring catchments. Shortlists are editorial discovery candidates, not rankings.
metadata.branding_note: Existing Hawai‘i PNG assets are referenced for eight providers. Other providers use live favicon proxies where an official website is known; brand assets are discovery references and have not been license-cleared for redistribution.
metadata.geocoding_note: ZIP codes and street addresses are stored when verified; coordinates intentionally left null in this pass. Geocode later with a chosen provider.
metadata.research_notes: The Jan. 5, 2026 Hawai‘i ADAD directory is the primary statewide source for contracted substance-use IOP/day-treatment locations. Provider pages and CARF/VA sources supplement it. Telehealth-only or city-only addresses remain explicitly flagged.
metadata.generation_note: Generated from source/areas and source/providers by tools/directory.py; edit canonical source files rather than this artifact.
